[P2] Plan the breaking StepConfig contract change

This changes an existing public field from a guaranteed `StepSemantics` to an optional value, affecting callers even when they never enable the new feature. For example, `StepConfig().step_semantics.value` now raises, and existing assignments to a `StepSemantics` variable fail type checking. The description acknowledges `None` but provides no breaking-release or migration plan. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 1.3's treatment of existing capabilities. Please return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) and agree on a compatible execution-default design or an explicitly planned breaking release.
